subject.title: fix(subagents): preserve requester wake on visible delivery failure

question: After the requester session has been woken successfully, should a missing required message-tool delivery become terminal immediately, or remain pending for bounded visible-delivery retries?
rationale: Both behaviors are internally coherent, but they define different user-visible delivery guarantees and cleanup semantics; repository history and tests do not establish which guarantee agents owners intend.

options.title: Keep bounded visible retry
options.body: Credit requester wake immediately but preserve the pending visible payload and retry state until delivery succeeds or the existing retry policy is exhausted.

options.title: Approve terminal split
options.body: Accept the PR's semantics that requester wake completes cleanup while required visible delivery and linked task delivery remain terminally failed.

options.title: Pause for broader redesign
options.body: Defer the PR until requester wake, visible delivery, retry, and task-status contracts are modeled as a unified state machine.

recommendation.title: Keep bounded visible retry
recommendation.body: Credit requester wake immediately but preserve the pending visible payload and retry state until delivery succeeds or the existing retry policy is exhausted.

likelyOwner.reason: The lifecycle and persistence boundary appears to originate from and remain heavily maintained by this feature-history owner.
